title: Our Vibrant Country
introduction: ‘Our Vibrant Country’ is treated as an inquiry-based learning unit. The chapter connects India’s geographic and cultural diversity, languages and traditions, food and clothing diversity, shared citizenship, respect for difference. Learners observe the situation, identify evidence, explain relationships, consider consequences and apply the learning to a new context without reproducing textbook wording.

Focus on India’s geographic and cultural diversity and languages and traditions, then look for evidence for food and clothing diversity. Finally, explain what you learned and how the idea can guide a decision or observation outside the chapter.
